purpose: Recover the SAT payload from ODA-produced DXF for the selected AC1021 3DSOLID and compare its torus fields and native geometry with the source-derived profile.

steps: Read the selected DXF 3DSOLID and retain group 1 and group 3 strings in order; append group 3 to its continued group-1 line.
Reverse the DXF caret escape by removing the inserted space in each encrypted '^ ' pair.
Apply the inverse SAT1 byte transform to each byte above ASCII space: plain = 0x9F - encrypted; preserve bytes at or below ASCII space.
Join SAT text lines with newline terminators.
payloadRecovery.implementationReference: LibreDWG 0.14 src/out_dxf.c dxf_3dsolid writes encrypted SAT1, inserts a space after caret bytes, and carries group-3 continuations; src/dwg_api.c dwg_encrypt_SAT1 implements the symmetric 0x9F byte transform.
payloadRecovery.comparison: The ACAD2007 and ACAD2010 recovered payloads are identical after the first three SAT header lines; the output timestamp differs.

independentParser.limitation: ACadRust parses and validates fields/topology references but has no B-rep kernel; its summary reports no edges, vertices, or subshells for this loopless torus profile.

nativeGeometry.parser: Pinned InventorLoader Acis.py revision e94bdf5e29052a0dc7ce6fdf755e956ae507caec; scratch-only compatibility adjustment strips the counted-string '@' before parsing the count; no entity or geometry logic changed.

disposition.resolved: A bounded external-producer semantic cross-check for selected AC1021 3DSOLID 0x452 torus data: ODA exports the entity/history relation; ACadRust independently parses the recovered 21200 SAT and matches the exact torus fields; native FreeCAD/OpenCASCADE reconstructs the same valid torus solid and analytic metrics as the source-derived selected route.
